# Impeccable — LeeWay Curated Design Craft

Modified/adapted by LeeWay Industries on 2026-10-06 from the attributed Impeccable design disciplines. This replaces the remote-only binding, not the upstream product. See SOURCE.json and provenance/ for pinned evidence, license and notices.

## Authority and admission

Use the existing Continuity → Context → Formula Governance → Skill Orchestrator → Tool Gateway → execution → Veritas → receipt path. This skill is design capability, not constitutional authority, a new agent, a renderer or a replacement for the Formula.

Resolve the canonical target and current revision before edits. Recover approved visual references, factual content, constraints, rejected directions and existing tokens/components. Read the project's authoritative equivalents of PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md; a missing filename does not imply a new project. Do not create duplicate context stores.

When Formula is used, bind the actual evaluator, verify its SHA-256 and trace the real input/output. Otherwise preserve UNEXPOSED / NOT_EXECUTED; do not invent scores, encodings or routing decisions. Ordinary authorized design work may continue without claiming Formula execution.

## Retained disciplines

These are skill operations, not a claim that upstream slash commands or its CLI were installed. Run only the requested operation and needed dependencies.

| Operation | Work to perform | Required evidence and boundary |
|---|---|---|
| `critique` | Explain task fit, hierarchy, cognitive load, readability and identity coherence. Separate design judgment from mechanical findings. | Identify the exact surface/revision and rendered examples where available. Label judgment as judgment. Read-only; do not silently redesign. |
| `audit` | Inspect accessibility, overflow, responsiveness, state truth, performance and implementation integrity. | Report measured failures and missing evidence independently. Read-only; a scan is not certification or proof of functional behavior. |
| `layout` | Repair reading order, grouping, spacing, density, alignment and safe regions. | Compare the same interaction states before/after. Preserve workflows, approved content and visual identity. |
| `typeset` | Refine established type roles, hierarchy, line wrapping, labels, captions and data readability. | Check actual font loading/fallback, long text and intended output sizes. Do not silently substitute approved fonts. |
| `adapt` | Reorganize the task for available space, input method and device capabilities. | Test declared viewports, zoom and touch/keyboard paths. Do not shrink a desktop canvas and call it mobile support. |
| `clarify` | Make controls, permissions, errors, recovery and progress understandable. | Preserve factual meaning and domain terms. Labels must match actual outcomes; never relabel configured/queued as executed/verified. |
| `animate` | Use motion to explain state, continuity, spatial relationship or authored narrative. | Inspect seek behavior and measured frame cost. Keep editor reduced-motion behavior separate from exported video timing. |
| `polish` | Repair remaining scoped inconsistencies after functional defects. | Reuse tokens/components and retest affected behaviors. No concealed redesign, invented claims or unbounded cosmetic churn. |

## Surface modes

For an editor, control panel or operational dashboard, prioritize task completion: legible controls, consistent state, predictable focus, useful density and reversible edits. For a scene, demonstration or narrative, let the approved content lead. Educational material favors comprehension; marketing favors a clear proposition. Determine the mode per surface, not for the whole product.

LeeWay's approved Digital Brain, elemental sphere, glass materials, palette and expressive identity remain intact unless the Creator authorizes changing them. A generic anti-pattern warning does not revoke approval. Keep editor chrome styling separate from composition styling; an editor theme must not rewrite the film.

## Reusable design inputs

Reuse established semantic tokens, shared components, safe-area rules and project-specific interaction conventions. Record a new token only when the existing design system truly lacks it. Route motion/color/geometry/frame-budget work to `skills/leeway-creative-rendering-engineering/SKILL.md`; use existing browser/accessibility tooling for collection and real interactions.

For HyperFrames, read [the LeeWay editor and composition profile](../hyperframes/references/leeway-design-profile.md). Its shared-capability handoffs include Formula, Cesium, Continuum, LDWMD and LeeWay GPU without making any of them subordinate identities or inventing a parallel execution layer.

## Deterministic checks and model boundary

`scripts/audit-measurements.mjs` is a dependency-free helper that evaluates supplied, revision-bound measurements. It has no network, model, installer, file mutation or authority-grant behavior. Its inputs must come from the existing authorized browser/renderer measurement path. Call `auditMeasurements(snapshot, requirements)`; see its tests for the input contract.

It checks only declared contrast limits, text overflow, frame/safe-region bounds, control size and frame budgets. Thresholds are explicit project requirements, not invented Formula constants or automatic accessibility certification. Missing required evidence, malformed values or revision mismatch cannot become success. A clean result means only the supplied measurements met the supplied limits; it does not authenticate their origin, assess visual taste or prove a real render.

Approved templates, tokens and executable composition rules can run without an LLM. Subjective critique still requires human or agent judgment. This skill does not turn free-form creative intent into an autonomous no-model design engine by itself.

## Excluded imports

Do not install the Impeccable application, self-downloading launcher, full command suite, binary detector, hooks, updater or platform packs as a side effect of using this skill. Do not introduce vendor assistants, accounts, paid APIs, analytics or model inference. No automatic theme replacement or blanket aesthetic bans.

The existing bulk sync manifest deliberately keeps this entry in `curatedSources`, outside `sources`. Updates require a scoped reviewed curation change with retained provenance. Do not run a whole-pack sync to repair this skill. Existing upstream payloads on another host are not authorized for deletion by this document.

## Acceptance and reporting

First fix blockers, then bounded refinement. Define the acceptance cases before mutation and preserve rollback. Use actual interaction, screenshot/frame and media evidence for the corresponding claims. Record source tests, native execution, visual acceptance, Formula execution and C3 status separately. Pass actual outputs to the existing Veritas/receipt owners; update the Learning Ledger only through its governed route.

Local package test: `node --test skills/external/impeccable/tests/*.test.mjs` from the resolved repository root. This qualifies the helper and source wiring, not a deployed HyperFrames editor.
